notes: Spellbreak (Proletariat) M_f_FireSimple family; owner-reported reuse licence in animations/SOURCE.md. EVIDENCE: parameter shells, static switches, function descriptions (CustomRotator, MF_PannerRotator, Luos_alphaErosion / MF_TransluscentToonErosion 'Erodes alpha mask instead of fade out'), and the uniform-expression sets parsed from the cooked inline shader maps of both roots and every static-switch instance (6 permutations): emissive uses rotator(TextureRotation) only with Has TextureRotation, speed, Distortion Scale, FPS, folded Distortion Scale*speed, UV Offset, Distortion factor, Noise 1/2 -> Mask, RGB -> Color Fade, Core1.a, Edge2.a, Edge1.a, Emissive Intensity; opacity (Alpha Erosion only) uses U/V Panner (+Rotator Speed with Has Rotator Speed), Erosion Texture, Erosion Scale, Debug Alpha, clamp(Edge Softness,0.01,1) (Toon Erosion only), max(Depth Fade Dist,0) (translucent/additive only). Textures: R core / G edge bands, B = background (Campfire5, FBCHeadMask), mask A = soft envelope. ALL VALUES from the instances. AUTHORED: noise layout and 0.1 distortion amplitude, erosion gradient = maskA*(0.5+0.5*noise), Debug Alpha as fade<->erode blend with dyn param 0 'Erosion' when IS PARTICLE, Color Fade driven by particle alpha, colour alphas as band weights, per-particle random in place of particle position, Erosion Scale as tiling, 0.2 distortion amplitude weighted to the texture top. DepthFade only for translucent/additive (the template reads its own RENDER_MODE list to skip masked/opaque, matching the source permutations; reading the depth texture from alpha-scissor materials made hair meshes vanish). NOTE: 'v4' colours need FxMaterials to unwrap {'ParameterValue': [...]} vectors.
